evidence.method: Browser computed-style audit on live DOM plus Playwright screenshots. Values below are live computed values, not guessed from old GitHub export.

dominant: primary action blue: header CTA, hero CTA, arrows, links, logo accent
main ink/headings and dark news/CTA sections
notPrimary: #005EFF is present mainly inside blue radial/gradient CTA strips; it is not the resting button color on the live pages audited.
#134EEF/#2B72DD appear as legacy/export residues and should not drive new UI without a fresh live use case.
#FA876B is not a live primary accent on audited pages.

typography.secondary: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif used for footer, prices/meta and some Gosha blocks
typography.bodyDefaultCaveat: body element falls back to Times New Roman, but meaningful visible text is styled per block; do not use Times as a token.

layout.sectionBackground: #F4F8FF light-first canvas; dark sections are exceptions (news/footer/CTA strips).
sectionRhythm: desktop gutters about 40px; content x often 53px at 1280 viewport
mobile is stacked and keeps the same light canvas

radiiAndDepth.shadows: Almost none on live core UI; one Gosha bubble uses 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,.1). Do not make heavy card shadows a default.

homeHero.surface: rounded 18px image cover block on #F4F8FF, about 40px side gutters
homeHero.overlay: dark graphite overlay/scrim over real photo, not abstract blue-glow gradient
homeHero.body: white text over image, large commercial intro
homeHero.buttons: primary #0088FF; secondary white background with #0088FF text

robotHero.surface: image-based dark hero on light canvas

catalogCards.model: Tilda t786 product grid: transparent card wrapper, square robot PNG/image on white, no border/shadow, text underneath
catalogCards.title: 22px Gillroy 700 #36323E line-height 30.8px

compilationCards.surface: image card 18px radius with dark bottom overlay
compilationCards.title: 28px Gillroy 700 white line-height 28px

tokenCorrections: Use #0088FF as resting primary CTA, not #005EFF.
Default cards should not have heavy shadows.
Default card/image radius is 18px; 30px is for selected product panels, not global card default.
Use normal/+1px heading tracking from live, not negative SaaS-style tracking.
Treat #F4F8FF as the global canvas; white is surfaces/buttons/images.
Catalog cards are not rounded/shadowed SaaS cards; they are transparent product tiles with square images.
